plugin.ctr.title: CTR mode (counter)
plugin.ctr.preset.short-message: A short message: no padding, the last keystream block is cut off
plugin.ctr.param.cipherHint: The block cipher E_K that turns each counter block into keystream.
plugin.ctr.param.keyHint: A key the block cipher accepts, e.g. 16, 24 or 32 bytes for AES.
plugin.ctr.param.counterHint: One block (16 bytes for AES), usually a nonce followed by a block counter. Never reuse it with the same key.
plugin.ctr.param.inputHint: Any length, at most 64 bytes. Encryption and decryption are the same operation.
plugin.ctr.op.encryptBlock: Encrypt the counter block with E_K (keystream)
plugin.ctr.op.xorKeystream: XOR the input with the keystream
plugin.ctr.step.initial_one: The input has {{bytes}} bytes, that is one block of up to {{blockSize}} bytes. CTR never feeds the input into {{cipher}}: it encrypts the counter blocks T₁ = {{counter}}, T₂ = T₁ + 1, … and XORs the resulting keystream with the input. That is why CTR needs no padding and decrypting is the same operation as encrypting.
plugin.ctr.step.initial_other: The input has {{bytes}} bytes, that is {{count}} blocks of up to {{blockSize}} bytes. CTR never feeds the input into {{cipher}}: it encrypts the counter blocks T₁ = {{counter}}, T₂ = T₁ + 1, … and XORs the resulting keystream with the input. That is why CTR needs no padding and decrypting is the same operation as encrypting.
plugin.ctr.step.incrementCounter: T{{n}} = T{{prev}} + 1 = {{counter}}. The whole block counts as one big-endian number; a carry runs into the byte to its left.
plugin.ctr.step.encryptBlock: Block {{n}}: {{cipher}} encrypts T{{n}} = {{counter}} to the keystream block {{keystream}}. It does not depend on the message at all, so it could be computed in advance.
plugin.ctr.step.xorKeystreamPartial: Block {{n}}: only {{used}} input bytes are left, so only the first {{used}} keystream bytes are used: {{input}} ⊕ {{keystream}} = {{output}}. The other {{unused}} keystream bytes are thrown away; no padding is needed.
plugin.ctr.error.invalidParams: Give the key, the counter block and the input as hex text.
plugin.ctr.error.keyLength: The key has {{length}} bytes; it needs 1 to 64.
plugin.ctr.error.counterLength: The counter block has {{length}} bytes; it needs 1 to 32.
plugin.ctr.error.inputLength: The input has {{length}} bytes; it needs 1 to 64.
plugin.ctr.error.counterBlockSize: The counter block has {{length}} bytes; this block cipher needs exactly {{blockSize}}.
